description: This file contains unit tests for network address iterators and adapters, using Google Test framework. It tests IPv4 and IPv6 address iteration, adapter status, and observer notifications within the WPEFramework core network components.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network adapters, providing methods to query adapter status and properties.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv4 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for IPv6 addresses associated with network adapters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter events.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a node to the adapter.

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets the gateway for a node.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a node from the adapter.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address for a node.

methods.name: IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is up.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is running.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses or adapters.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the adapter.
